study_identification_part.si4_title: Individualized cortical thickness asymmetry in Autism Spectrum Disorders and Schizophrenia

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study explicitly states its aim to use normative modeling to investigate individual-level deviations in cortical thickness asymmetry in ASD and schizophrenia, clarifying the purpose of applying this method.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: This study's aims to assess and analyze the heterogeneity of regional cortical thickness asymmetry in a large, multi-scanner sample of healthy individuals as well as those with ASD or SZ.

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: We examined data for 5430 healthy individuals... taken from 20 different scan sites... We initially included only images from ABIDE that we denoted as the highest quality... we excluded 682 images with an IQR >2.8... images were removed if the maximum, absolute, within-dataset centered Euler number was larger than 10.
